summary: AI voice production agent that gets names, numbers and pronunciation right in every language and catches misses before you ship the audio.

pricing.details: Free 0 €/month — 1,000 credits one-time, TTS auto-route, mispronunciation fixes, 10 languages, 1 workspace, 1 GB storage. Creator 14 €/month billed yearly (“Save 20%”) — 3,000 credits/month, 3 concurrent pipeline runs, 100 GB, email support. Studio 72 €/month billed yearly — 15,000 credits/month, 3 workspaces, 500 GB, email + Slack, bring your own key. Scale 217 €/month billed yearly — 50,000 credits/month, 10 concurrent runs, 5 workspaces, 1 TB, lowest overage rate. Enterprise custom.
